title: 2580-2582 Vancouver Street VNFC: courtyard opening sprinkler proposal

facts.text: Cover identifies 2580/2582 Vancouver Street, six-storey 40-unit project with VNFC ground-floor programming; BCBC 2024.
AS table identifies 15 windows and 22 doors on east/west courtyard walls near exit stairs and proposes water-curtain sprinklers.
Table cites BCBC 3.2.3.13 and says proposal is subject to AHJ acceptance.

The related A0.03 sheet describes the exit-exposure condition, states that the passageways cannot accommodate both 1,100 mm exit width and 3.0 m separation from perpendicular openings, and charts spatial-separation values for courtyard faces.

limitations: British Columbia comparative material only; it cannot establish Alberta code performance or applicability.
Related A03 spatial-separation sheet was read with PDFium after pypdf hit a token limit; neither file shows AHJ acceptance.
